notes.title: More Cars!
notes.content:
In today’s devlog, we’re presenting another fully completed car model in Car Rental Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/6711b9e105be581f2d03aa1eb45ce4c47eb149a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/4ec850e060d637f91de14ad828791d1a759632da.png[/img]

Remember - the size of your fleet determines the success of your rental business! As your company grows, it’s worth investing in more vehicles - ideally, a diverse range - so you can offer the exact models your customers dream about. And as we all know, customers have their preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/d9096148fcd00d27946d55b2ead24c4bd8b45f66.gif[/img]

Beyond brand and color, condition and cleanliness will of course be important - and don’t forget the full tank. But in upcoming devlogs, we’ll reveal even more customer demands that are worth keeping in mind when building your rental offer. Stay tuned to Steam and our Discord channel!

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

While you wait for Car Rental Simulator, be sure to check out Car Dealer Simulator! Recent updates added new junkyard features and an online car parts shop.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Welcome to the Exciting World of Automotive Business!
notes.content:
In today’s devlog, we want to tell you a bit more about Lazy Luke’s family.

As you already know from previous devlogs, his nickname isn’t just for show. Lazy Luke is… well, lazy. He’s not exactly a business genius, and he’d rather spend money than earn it. That’s why your help in running the rental business will be absolutely essential.

Don’t expect this bluebird to help you expand the fleet, fix cars, or deal with customers. What is guaranteed? A lot of jokes - and constant requests for cash.

Let’s meet his family:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/87ecc28e692fe1d5962dfab9c9e56313dfa55ef1.png[/img]

Lazy Luke takes after his father, Little Sam, in more ways than one.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2404880/view/500579345320902668

If you’ve played Car Dealer Simulator, you’ve probably met him. He’s rarely around, always off doing something "important," and constantly on the phone. Luckily, his role is mostly to introduce you to the game - and if you earn enough cash, you can buy the dealership from him. 😊

On the other hand, completely different is Little Sam’s wife and Lazy Luke’s mother - Clever Emma.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3542300/view/538859942242680861

Clever Emma is all about order. After finishing her role as a homemaker and mother, she decided to open her own business – Car Cleaner. Now that she’s a bit older and getting tired, she’ll need your help too.

Join the conversation and become part of our community:

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

Working in all of these businesses - with the chance to buy them and make them your own - is your opportunity to build your automotive kingdom in Wingston Springs!

Want to test your skills in Car Cleaner Simulator? Take matters into your own hands and build a true car wash empire - add it to your wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542300/Car_Cleaner_Simulator/

While waiting for Car Rental Simulator and Car Cleaner Simulator, why not enjoy the first game in the series-Car Dealer Simulator? It’s now 10% off and includes brand-new features from the Junkyard Update:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Rental cars!
notes.content:
Take a look at one of the car models we’re currently working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/c0a6c60839fc6e89bd5668abc73e636b68d3563a.gif[/img]

In Car Rental Simulator one of the key tasks is inspecting the vehicle returned by the customer - check both cleanliness and damage.

The business needs to be profitable - charging customers extra based on the condition of returned cars will affect the game’s economy.

Stay sharp - inspect every car carefully.

Follow our devlogs - and feel free to share your feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: Meet Lazy Luke!
notes.content:
In today’s devlog, we’d like to introduce you to the owner of the Car Rental.

Meet Lazy Luke - the son of Little Sam, who you can get to know better in Car Dealer Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/c4136fff2c1f44167799a60e5e3f7bf422e890fb.gif[/img]

So, who is Lazy Luke? He’s a young guy who isn’t exactly known for his work ethic, even though his father would love to turn him into a proper businessman. Sadly, Luke prefers traveling and partying, so running a business is the last thing on his mind. He’s got a good sense of humor, so expect a joker rather than a real boss. He enjoys spending money more than making it - because life’s too good to be taken seriously 😊

He lives off Little Sam’s generosity, though his father is starting to lose patience. That’s why the first few cars in the Car Rental come straight from his dad’s business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/6d1290f9aa2fbac4e46814517c0c335c5e3271a7.jpg[/img]

Make sure to follow our devlogs and share your thoughts and suggestions with us.

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

While waiting for Car Rental Simulator, check out Car Dealer Simulator, available now on Steam. It’s your chance to meet Lazy Luke’s father, Little Sam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Welcome to Car Rental Simulator!
notes.content:
We’re excited to welcome you to our very first devlog for [i]Car Rental Simulator[/i]. Yes - production has already started, and with this post, we’re officially kicking off our regular devlog series.

As you can see on our store page, the game is being developed by [i]Play2Chill[/i], and [i]Garage Monkeys[/i] is taking on the role of publisher.

[i]Car Rental Simulator[/i] is set in the small town of Wingston Springs. The business is run by Lazy Luke, but it’s up to you to get the place back in shape. Growing your rental empire will depend on your car selection, marketing skills, and management abilities. Here's what the place currently looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/d3880757eea77f518e280bd776d8ba0af9f700ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/442d8a8c6b7c720326c9b4540c5e81d969634637.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/29ad2799d54502757cf3016ab57cdb3922cec901.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/e2ae13c26db3dc4e01c3e16981045d0ac9fce210.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/4d3c2f5970ed1ef6a582b28179bd029cc42df5e2.png[/img]

You can also invite your friends to join the fun - the game will feature co-op mode.

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312481/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

If you want to get to know the town better, check out the first game in the series - [i]Car Dealer Simulator[/i], which is already available. And it’s worth getting to know the family too - [i]Car Dealer[/i] is run by Little Sam, the father of Lazy Luke.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/
